---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new control, check type, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like to add?**
e.g. a new CIS-inspired control, a new distribution, an export format.

**Category / check type**
Which category does it belong to, and does an existing check type cover it?

**Rationale**
Why does this control/feature matter for hardening?

**Distribution scope**
Which distributions/versions should it apply to?

**Additional context**
Links to the relevant CIS Benchmark theme or documentation (no exact section
numbers required).
